_comment: Labeled corpus for agent SELECTION tests (Tier 1 hermetic discriminability lint, Tier 2a LLM-judge, Tier 2b real-session offload-coverage). Each entry: {id, prompt, expect:[primary,...acceptable], note, ambiguous?, inline_ok?}. expect[0] is the primary correct agent; the rest are genuinely-acceptable neighbours (selection is fuzzy). THREE labeling modes: (1) normal expect:[...] — a pick in expect is required (an expect agent MUST be selected). (2) ambiguous:true (expect:[]) — a specialized agent should NOT be selected (the main thread answers inline; judge → 'none'; real-session → no-offload is the win). (3) inline_ok:true together with a NON-EMPTY expect:[...] of generalist-tier agents — a pick in expect is correct, AND declining/answering inline (judge → 'none'; real-session → no-offload) is ALSO correct; picking any agent NOT in expect is WRONG. inline_ok entries are DECISIVE (they have a definite expectation), not ambiguous — the ambiguous bucket keys on ambiguous:true, never on an empty expect. NON-CIRCULARITY RULE: prompts are phrased the way a real user/main-thread would, deliberately NOT reusing the quoted example phrases in agents/*.md descriptions — otherwise the lexical lint and judge degrade into circular keyword matching. Placeholders {{PY}} (a code file), {{DIR}} (a directory), {{PLAN}} (a plan file) are substituted with real scratch paths by the real-session harness; the hermetic + judge loaders replace them with neutral nouns.
